posts.post:
spending 5k on a shirt that falls apart in three washes isn't premium. 

it’s just a bad investment.

the most stylish guy in the room is usually wearing the least amount of branding. 

that's a fact.
there is a specific kind of confidence in wearing the exact same outfit two days in a row.

we spent six weeks testing fabric weights just to make a tee that holds its shape. 

most people probably won't even notice the difference.
